snippet.async_client:
import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedApi

client = AsyncSeedApi(
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.asset_report.get_pdf(
        asset_report_token="asset_report_token",
    )


asyncio.run(main())
